描述_EN: 94a) shows the secretary, under a mahogany-framed mirror, next to a crossbeam. plate xvii-n°2 by krafft and ransonnette (fig. the ornamentation and execution, on the other hand, are refined. The design is highly geometric: a sharp-edged parallelepiped with a square façade, punctuated by gilded bronze moldings and enhanced by a small plinth. like the bed, the secretary was part of madame recamier's bedroom furniture. the frames of the door and flap are highlighted with ebony and pewter fillets; a frieze of stars between two gilded bronze moldings, continuing along the sides, distinguishes the lower part from the upper part of the desk. the genies' wings were more folded and took up less space;the position of the legs was less plausible and the garland of flowers was prolonged instead of ending in ribbons. madame récamier kept her secretary, which can be found with the chest of drawers in her basse-du-rempart bedroom. the frieze of stars ran all the way around the lower section and, as with the bed, berthault lightened it. the door on the lower part reveals three English-style drawers. the differences between the project and its execution are minimal. On the flap, two genii, one knee on the ground, hold up a ribbon to support an entwined garland, reminiscent of the one on the bed; finally, four bees surround the keyhole. At the bottom, between two very linear flowers, a winged woman sits on a low stool, feet together, delicately holding a cord in front of an urn on a stele: this could be Psyche uncorking the flask entrusted to her by Persephone in the underworld, and the woman falls into a deep sleep as a result. The story of Psyche was already evoked in Madame Recamier's bedroom as a door overlay (and probably on the chest of drawers, visible in Berthault's designs), and we've already seen, in the case of the bed, a desire to link ornamentation to the themes of night and sleep. This is a small lady's secretary, whose flap, lined with red morocco, conceals three drawers, topped by three compartments. the decor is in harmony with the rest of the room: the stars, the garland, the long flowers on the base of the chinard statue. finally, the owner's initials, j.r., framed the lock.
描述_ZN: 94a）显示了秘书在红木框架的镜子下，在横梁的旁边。 KRAFFT和RANSONNETTE的第十七-N°2版（图）。 的装饰和执行，另一方面，也很精致。 该设计是高度几何化的：一个棱角分明的平行四边形，有一个正方形的立面，由镀金的青铜模子点缀，并由一个小基座加强。 和床一样，秘书也是雷玛尔夫人卧室家具的一部分。 门框和挡板上突出了乌木和锡制的花边；两个镀金的铜制模子之间的星星楣，沿着两侧延伸，将书桌的下部和上部区分开来。 年，精灵的翅膀更加折叠，所占空间更小；腿的位置不太合理，花环被延长而不是以丝带结束。 年，雷玛尔夫人保留了她的秘书，这与她在地下室的房间里的抽屉柜一起被发现。 年，星星的浮雕一直围绕着下部，和床一样，贝托尔把它照亮了。 下部的门显示了三个英式抽屉。 项目和执行之间的差异很小。 在挡板上，两个精灵，一个跪在地上，举着一条丝带，支撑着一个缠绕的花环，让人联想到床上的那个花环；最后，四只蜜蜂围绕着钥匙孔。 在底部，在两朵非常有线条感的花之间，一个长着翅膀的女人坐在一个低矮的凳子上，双脚并拢，在石碑上的骨灰盒前巧妙地拿着一根绳子：这可能是普西克在冥界打开珀尔塞福涅托付给她的酒壶，而这个女人因此陷入了沉睡。 在雷卡米尔夫人的卧室里，赛琪的故事已经作为门套被唤起了（可能还在抽屉柜上，在贝尔托尔的设计中可以看到），而且我们已经看到，在床的案例中，人们希望将装饰品与夜晚和睡眠的主题联系起来。 这是一个小型的女秘书，其翻盖上有红色摩洛哥的内衬，隐藏着三个抽屉，上面有三个隔层。 装饰与房间的其他部分相协调：星星、花环、奇纳德雕像底座上的长花。 最后，主人的姓名缩写j.r.镶在锁上。
